author: Noema II
title: SE-shared DSConv + mean+max pooling + BiGRU + Motif(k=5,max) + task-type heads — seed=42
abstract: Align pooled DSConv features with SOTA (mean+max) while retaining Channel SE, BiGRU, a lightweight motif-detector expert (k=5→global max), scalar 3-way fusion, and small task-type heads. Tests average gains and CRI-Off lift under a universal <1M design.
